deepdive.sec: Renewable IPP + Solar/Wind EPC (integrated developer-cum-EPC; Gujarat-led "captive power producer" model)

bull_bear.body:
- IPP funded from long-term debt; OCF kept positive (IPP requires ~no working capital, unlike CPP). 
- **Green bond:** INR 670 cr, 5-yr, 8.50% coupon, quarterly amortization, 65% partial guarantee from GuarantCo, rated AA+(CE) (CRISIL/ICRA) — India's first externally credit-enhanced green bond.
- **Promoter pledge:** ~50% of promoter shares pledged (pre-IPO collateral); SBI sanctioned release upon COD of 250/370 MW (within 3 months) — expected fully released by Mar'27.
- Sundrops IPO to fund BESS; InvIT a future option for Botswana equity.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Falling ROE/ROCE (18-19%→13-14%, may dip further FY27); EPS dilution lag vs PAT.
- Interest cost ramp (peak ~INR 300 cr) and >2x finance/depreciation lines.
- Inventory 4x build-up (execution/geopolitical hedge but ties up capital).
- Repeated downward revision of long-term CAGR guidance (sector "less acceleration").
- RE curtailment during peak hours + transmission/evacuation bottlenecks (CTU projects only by FY28-30); no concrete CERC verdict yet.
- BESS margin/IRR uncertainty (VGF-dependent, not yet viable standalone).
- Khavda-style execution delays from third-party (GSECL) substation scope.
- Single REIA (SECI consolidation) — execution/tendering dependency.
- High promoter pledge until Mar'27 release.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, granular and reasonably candid (CFO Salim Yahoo gave segment-level EBITDA, CODs, pledge timeline). Did NOT disclose with/without-material EPC split ("our business"). Persistent audio issues truncated several analyst questions (notably Anil Sarin's BESS IRR question went unanswered). Tone defensive on guidance step-down — repeatedly reframed as sector deceleration rather than company-specific, while emphasizing peer-relative outperformance.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The guidance "downgrade" (70-80% → 40-50% CAGR over ~2 years) is the real signal beneath strong headline numbers — and the stock has de-rated on the IPP dilution trough, not on growth concern.
- IPP transition is structurally cash-flow-accretive (no working capital) but near-term EPS/ROE-dilutive — a classic annuity build-out J-curve.
- Inventory 4x is a deliberate supply-chain hedge against panel/turbine availability + price (geopolitics), not distress.
- Sundrops being carved out as the BESS + battery-manufacturing IPO vehicle could create a separate listed value driver.
- Power-trading licenses (CERC+GERC) are an under-discussed optionality — better realization/portfolio flexibility.
- BESS economics are honestly described as weak without VGF — mgmt is not over-promising here.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Equity-raise history: ₹300 crore QIP in 2023, a second QIP of ₹1,000 crore in 2024, and ₹670 crore in 2025 via India's first externally credit enhanced green bond.
- Stated funding philosophy: an 'INTERNAL EQUITY POOL' fed by CPP cash margin plus IPP cash margin funds project equity, so 'This model facilitates growth of our annuity asset base without continuous equity dilution — building scale and long-term cash flow at the same time.'
- Credit rating shown as A(Stable) from ICRA, and AA+(CE) from CRISIL and ICRA for the Green Bond issue.
- Shareholding as of June 30, 2026: Promoter group 51.9% and Public 48.1%, '# Factoring in dilution from warrants issued to Promoter'; key institutional holders listed include Vanguard, Government Pension Fund Global, Blackrock, Fivex Capital, State Street Group, SBI General Insurance, Ökoworld Growing Markets and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Installed: 1.62 GW; WIP: 4.64 GW; installed+upcoming ~6.26 GW** (2.57 GW IPP + 3.69 GW CPP). IPP to generate >390 cr units/yr (annuity base).
- **IPP CODs:** 250 MW Oct'26; 370 MW Oct'26; 150 MW wind Nov'27; 300 MW SJVN — no COD (PPA unsigned, ~18-24 months after signing).
- **Sundrops Energia (subsidiary):** FY26 top line INR 586 cr, PBT INR 130 cr, PAT INR 97 cr. DRHP/IPO this FY; now the dedicated BESS + battery manufacturing vehicle.
- **Khavda IPP:** Revenue delayed ~6-7 months (GSECL govt substation incomplete); partial billing started, PPA tenure extended to compensate.
- **Land bank:** 7,210 acres; only ~800-1,000 acres owned, rest 26-27 yr farmer/private leases.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| IPP capex build-out → near-term ROE/EPS dilution trough | KPI Green Energy (KPIGREEN · 542323) — long-term annuity beneficiary | KPIGREEN (near-term: de-rated, ROE down to ~13-14%) | Self. Strong annuity & cash flow from FY27-28, but FY26-28 dilutive. Conviction: Med-High (clearly articulated, mgmt-confirmed). |
| Panel/turbine price + availability (geopolitics) | KPIGREEN (pre-stocked inventory + vendor advances protect margin) | Late/under-hedged EPC peers | Self benefits relatively; inventory hedge maintains 16-18% EPC EBITDA. Conviction: Med. |
| BESS firm-dispatch mandate (FDRE) across states | KPIGREEN / Sundrops Energia (unlisted subsidiary, IPO pending); Adani Group (code unverified) as scale RE player | Pure solar IPPs lacking storage | Mandatory storage = new addressable market; KPI has 2 GUVNL BESS orders. Conviction: Med. |
| Maharashtra grid-stabilization charges on CPP | Gujarat/other-state CPP developers (incl. KPIGREEN, no MH rooftop exposure) | Maharashtra CPP/rooftop developers | KPI has negligible MH CPP exposure today; charge erodes MH captive economics. Conviction: Low-Med (mgmt still evaluating). |
| RE curtailment + transmission/evacuation bottlenecks | Grid/transmission EPC & PGCIL-linked players (code unverified); KPIGREEN (holds evacuation + land bank moat) | Sub-scale IPPs without evacuation tie-ups | Evacuation/land are KPI's stated moats; weak-grid peers stranded. Conviction: Med. |
| Single REIA (SECI) consolidation + pan-India tendering | Large equipped bidders incl. KPIGREEN (75% historical win ratio) | Sub-scale/under-resourced bidders | Clearer tendering favors well-capitalized integrated players. Conviction: Low-Med. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- 'Double Engine Business Model': CPP (Captive Power Producer, EPC model — the company secures land, designs, builds and commissions the plant, asset ownership transfers to the customer, and it runs long-term O&M and power supply) alongside IPP (BOO model — 100% asset ownership, 25-year PPAs with Utility and C&I off-takers, recurring revenue across the full asset life).
- Positioned as a 'One Stop End-to-End Solutions Provider' with capabilities across Rooftop, Ground Mounted and Floating Solar, Wind, and BESS across Utility and C&I segments.
- Flagship company of KP Group, a conglomerate founded in 1994 by Dr. Faruk G. Patel with 32+ years, 9.2+ GW group capacity and a 10 GW 2030 group target; sister entities are KP Energy (wind BoP/turnkey), KP Green Engineering (steel structures, 23 products, Matar plant houses 'Asia's largest kettle for galvanizing') and KP Green Hydrogen & Ammonia.
- Clientele cited includes GUVNL, DGVCL, MAHAGENCO, NTPC, SJVN, Coal India, Indian Air Force, Adani Green Energy, Aditya Birla Renewable Energy, L&T, Tata Motors, Ayana Renewables, Zydus Lifescience, Gujarat Fluorochemicals, UPL, RR Kabel and Polycab.
- Counterparty concentration disclosed: 'All Utility scale projects (Other than C&I and Kusum) have GUVNL as the offtaker, with the exception of the 300 MW Wind project, which is backed by SJVN'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Leadership] Board strengthened with two inductions: Prof. Sunil Maheshwari as Vice-Chairman (former IIMA Professor of HRM and Strategy and Dean, IIT Delhi alumnus, ex-Advisor to the Minister of HRD) and Mr. Rajesh Shrivastava as Whole-Time Director (nearly 37 years across power/infrastructure/renewables, associated with more than 30 GW of power projects, ex-Reliance New Energy, Aditya Birla Renewables, Adani Green, Toshiba JSW and NTPC).
- [Policy] Enablers cited: BESS viability-gap funding of ₹18L/MWh for 30 GWh; must-run status meaning RE 'cannot be curtailed for commercial reasons — guaranteed dispatch & offtake'; RPO/RCO mandates rising from 35.95% in FY27 to ~43.33% by FY30; ISTS charge waiver locked in for 25 years for projects commissioned before 2028; and a GST cut from 12% to 5% on RE equipment (Sep 2025) that 'lowers LCOE'.
- [Policy] Newly approved PM Surya Sarovar Yojana — a ₹5,070 Cr scheme for 5 GW of floating solar with 2-hour storage over FY 2027-31 — relevant to the company's floating-solar platform.
- [Industry] India installed non-fossil capacity of 283 GW in FY26 against a CY30 target of 500 GW, with FY26 seeing a record 55 GW capacity addition; RE share of installed capacity expected to rise from 50% in FY27P to 66% by FY36P.
- [Listing history] Incorporated 2008, listed on the BSE SME Board in 2019, migrated to the Main Board of NSE and BSE in 2021.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- EPC EBITDA 16-18%; IPP EBITDA ~85-90%; blended 33-36%. Margin lever = raise IPP share.
- Input cost (panels/turbines = 60-70% of project cost) hedged via advances to vendors + inventory pre-stocking → protects EPC margin.
- Maharashtra grid-stabilization charges: under evaluation for CPP feasibility; not present in Gujarat/other states currently.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- IPP capacity crossed 1 GW (vs 965 MW at 31-Mar-26) intra-quarter.
- Guidance stepped down again: prior-call 50-60% CAGR → now 40-50% (through FY30).
- CPP order book stated at INR 5,246 cr (mgmt reconciled vs prior ~INR 6,000 cr via execution + new wins; investor flagged confusion).
- New green bond (INR 670 cr, AA+(CE), GuarantCo-guaranteed) listed — India's first externally credit-enhanced green bond.
- CERC interstate + GERC intrastate power-trading licenses newly secured.
- Sundrops Energia formally designated BESS/battery-mfg vehicle; DRHP/IPO targeted this FY.
- Botswana 100% step-down subsidiary (via GIFT City) incorporated; PPA signing imminent; 500 MW by Dec'27.
- Promoter pledge release pathway confirmed via SBI sanction (full release expected by Mar'27).
- Interest cost ~+130% YoY, depreciation >2x, inventory ~4x — flagged this quarter as IPP/working-capital ramp effects.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **Growth:** 40-50% YoY revenue growth committed, reiterated through FY30 (notably stepped DOWN over time: from 70-80% → 60-70% → 50-60% → now 40-50%; mgmt attributes to sector "less acceleration" / geopolitics, not internal slowdown).
- **Margins:** Maintain/improve combined EBITDA 33-36% by raising IPP mix (IPP ~85-90% EBITDA) to offset EPC strain (EPC EBITDA 16-18%).
- **ROE:** Expect to "curtail the drop" this year (FY27); ROE to return toward earlier levels next year.
- **IPP capacity:** Already crossed 1 GW (as of call) from 965 MW at 31-Mar-26; targeting ~1.7 GW IPP additions this FY.
- **10 GW by 2030 target** — mgmt claims it will be hit ahead of schedule.
outlook.title: Guidance (next quarter / forward)

outlook.body:
- **CPP/EPC order book: INR 5,246 cr** (~2.7 GW equivalent; some with material, some BoP-only). ~INR 1,500 cr already executed, ~INR 3,679 cr remaining (excludes many small Sundrop orders). (Note: investor flagged confusion vs prior ~INR 6,000 cr commentary — mgmt reconciled via milestone billing + new wins.)
- **Bid pipeline: 4-5 GW** under participation; historical win ratio ~75%, going forward selective toward higher-margin / faster-execution tenders.
- **FY26 wins:** 150 MW wind (GUVNL); 445/890 MWh & 120/240 MWh standalone BESS (GUVNL); 142 MW floating solar; 250 MW solar (SJVN); 1.13 GW solar BoP (Adani Group); 300 MW wind (SJVN).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **BESS** (via Sundrops; GUVNL orders; VGF-supported INR 18-27 lakh/MW; margins below IPP, batteries ~12-yr life; states Rajasthan/Maharashtra/Gujarat policies).
- **Green hydrogen** (free transmission charges to 2035; steel-sector pull).
- **Floating solar** (142 MW won; Odisha bidding).
- **Power trading** — secured interstate (CERC) + intrastate (GERC) licenses → pan-India exchange/bilateral access.
- **Botswana / Africa:** 500 MW commitment by Dec'27, step-down subsidiary via GIFT City, in-principle international fund approvals; InvIT optionality.
- **Offshore wind, pumped storage, Agrivolt** — early stage. Geographic expansion: Rajasthan, Karnataka, Odisha entered; MP, Maharashtra next.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: High-growth integrated Gujarat renewable developer (IPP + EPC) compounding revenue/PAT ~55-57% with a deliberate, capex-heavy pivot toward annuity IPP — accepting a near-term ROE/EPS dilution trough (FY26-FY28) for a stronger, higher-margin annuity book thereafter.
